setup_instructions: 1. Copy .claude/ directory to your new music app project
2. Ensure global MCP secrets are configured (~/.config/claude-mcp/mcp-secrets.env)
3. Install Firebase CLI: npm install -g firebase-tools
notes: This template is optimized for music practice apps with audio playback features
Includes comprehensive accessibility support for young users (age 10+)
PWA-ready with offline-first architecture and service workers
Multi-tenant Firebase architecture with proper security rules
Pitch preservation audio playback using Web Audio API
